summary_own_words: Turn-based battle core: client/server proc structure with per-client action selection, an action-order search, mid-turn switching, and a field-status record that counts down timed effects including weather turns. A pooled event-list system queues battle events with a variable stack, and a calculation work record holds a move list plus an RNG context with ratio (numerator/denominator) helpers. A link adapter record carries command/size/data-buffer plus a reply-arrived flag, and a recorder component stores battle records. Data shapes: per-client/position records keyed by client id, sequence/state/counter fields, palette and cell-animation handles; dominant field types are unsigned 32/8-bit with boolean flags.
